contract: Every difference an operator can observe between aw-pre-merge and the merged tree, with team mode UNSET, is declared here with a reason. A difference with no row FAILS the gate; a row whose difference has gone ALSO fails it, naming the row to delete. A prose row carries both texts, so it licenses THAT difference and not the next one.
